interface.shortDescription: Send SMS, WhatsApp, email and more
interface.longDescription: Send and check the status of real-time and broadcast messages across every channel your Soprano Connect API account supports - SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, Voice, Viber and Mobile Push - plus manage WhatsApp media and list approved WhatsApp templates. Requires an existing Soprano Design Connect API account with the relevant channel licenses provisioned. Intended for teams and developers already using Soprano Connect who want to trigger messages conversationally instead of through the Connect portal/API directly.
